resources.string: Have your banks and brokerages fill in the sheet's balances every day.
Checking, savings and cards, plus any loans or investments held at the same bank
A brokerage, a 401(k) or an IRA provider, with what each account holds
A student loan servicer or a mortgage lender, with its rate and next payment

Link a bank, a brokerage or a lender once, and its balances are read every morning and written to your budget sheet. You sign in on Plaid's page, at your bank's own sign-in where it has one. This app never sees your password.
Sandbox: Plaid's practice banks, with made-up money
Choose your institution on Plaid's page and sign in. Come back here when it says you're done, and this page catches up by itself.
Linking was left unfinished. Nothing was linked.
That link ran out before it was finished. Start again when you're ready.
%1$s wants you to sign in again before its balances can be read.
The last read didn't work: %1$s. These are the balances from the read before.

Plaid is told to forget it, the server deletes its key, and its rows leave the feed, so any cell in your budget sheet that looks them up will show an error until you change it. On Plaid's free plan every link counts toward its 10 for good, so linking it again later uses up another.

Each account has a key in the feed's first column and its balance in the second. In your budget sheet, replace a typed balance with a lookup of its key: =VLOOKUP("key", IMPORTRANGE("feed sheet address", "Bank feed!A:B"), 2, FALSE)

Each cell goes back to the number it held before, unless it has been changed since. Those lines are then paused, so the next sync doesn't write them again. Resume a line when you're ready.
Put back. Those lines are paused until you resume them.
%1$d of %2$d cells were put back. The rest had been changed since, so they were left. Those lines are paused.

A cell is found by the label beside it every time, so adding rows doesn't move a write onto the wrong cell, and only a typed number or an empty cell is ever replaced. The list of cells is sheet-fill.json on the server (docs/bank-sync.md).
Bank sync isn't set up yet
The server needs a Plaid client id and secret before anything can be linked. Put them in plaid.env beside the relay (docs/bank-sync.md has the steps) and deploy the relay again.
Bank sync runs on your PercySafe server, so it shows once you're connected.

Plaid reads balances, holdings and loan terms. Nothing here can move money. Your server keeps one read-only key per institution and this phone never holds one. Everything is read again each morning, and Sync now reads it at once.
The relay on the server is older than bank sync. Copy relay/ to the server and run docker compose up -d --build there.
Tailscale isn't connected on this device, so the server can't be reached. A phone runs one VPN at a time, so turning on another VPN switches Tailscale off. Connect Tailscale, then try again.
